prsInitiated.source: github (PRs named by the delivery ledger, run summaries and runner branches)
prsInitiated.definition: Pull requests opened in the window (records through 2026-10-16) on other repositories that a product record names.

prsPassedCi.source: github (PRs named by the delivery ledger, run summaries and runner branches)
prsPassedCi.definition: Initiated PRs whose current head commit passed CI (check runs and commit statuses), out of those whose CI could be read; coverage counts them against every initiated PR. A PR whose CI was unreadable is never counted as failed.

prsMerged.source: github (PRs named by the delivery ledger, run summaries and runner branches)
prsMerged.definition: Product-initiated PRs on other repositories that merged in the window (records through 2026-10-16).

proposalsRejected.definition: Proposals the operator rejected, each with a reason.
proposalsRejected.reason: The delivery ledger held no decision by the window end: accepts and rejects were not recorded.

operatorSeconds.definition: Operator seconds across every decision and reported outcome review.
operatorSeconds.reason: The delivery ledger held no decision by the window end: operator time was not recorded.

operatorSecondsPerMergedImprovement.definition: Total operator seconds divided by merged improvements.
operatorSecondsPerMergedImprovement.reason: The delivery ledger held no decision by the window end: operator time was not recorded.

agentRuns.definition: Runner runs in the window on real repositories (smoke fixtures excluded), every status.

agentRunsFailed.definition: Runner runs in the window that failed, were blocked by a gate, or were refused (cancelled runs are not counted); failureCauses names why.

reposReady.definition: Audited repositories whose dispatch readiness is ready: eligible to receive agent work.
reposReady.reason: The docs audit cache keeps only its latest audit (2026-11-01), which is after the window ends; readiness at the window end was not recorded.
